image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Archelon ischyros from the config library at the starting line of the Pierre Shale seaway. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Thick, leathery slate-grey skin with weathered-tarp texture and barnacle-like scarring; massive, hooked raptorial beak; oversized front flippers spanning nearly 5 meters. ACTION: Gliding majestically at a slight upward angle toward the sunlit surface, flippers fully extended like wings. FACIAL EXPRESSION: Wise, ancient, and methodical, with large, dark, heavy-lidded eyes. SETTING: Deep indigo water with god-rays illuminating marine snow. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3'. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' front-three-quarter view showing the massive scale of the flippers.
